questions.question:
Pointing to a baby girl in a cradle, Sripad said, "She is the daughter of my father's mother's only daughter's elder daughter".

How is the baby girl's mother related to Sripad?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fd6cab610f720d74911a910004a74b250f0cafb23fad64b63aa6509fbfac474.png] 

Sripad Said:- 

The family tree is given below:-She is the daughter of my father's mother's only daughter's elder daughter.

Here, My(Sripad) father's mother = Sripad's Paternal Grandmother.

Sripad's Paternal Grandmother's only daughter's = Sripad's paternal Aunt.

Sripad's paternal Aunt's elder daughter = Sripad's cousin sister daughter.

Sripad's cousin sister's daughter(Baby Girl) = Sripad's neice.
